options.name: __header
options.description: Ansible ansible_managed string to put in header of file should be in the format of {{ ansible_managed | comment }} as rendered by the template module

options.name: auto_renew
options.description: Indicates if the certificate should be renewed automatically before it expires.

options.name: booted
options.description: The role is run in a booted system and can directly talk to services. If false, the certificate generation will be deferred to the first boot.

options.name: ca
options.description: CA that will issue the certificate. The available options will vary depending on each provider.

options.name: common_name
options.description: Common Name requested for the certificate subject.

options.name: contact_email
options.description: Contact email requested for the certificate subject.

options.name: country
options.description: Country requested for the certificate subject.

options.name: directory
options.description: Directory where certificate and key will be stored. Only used if I(name) is not an absolute path.

options.name: dns
options.description: Domain (or list of domains) to be included in the certificate. Also can provide the default value for I(common_name).

options.name: email
options.description: Email (or list of emails) to be included in the certificate. Also can provide the default value for I(common_name).

options.name: extended_key_usage
options.description: Extended Key Usage attributes to be present in the certificate request.

options.name: group
options.description: Group name (or group id) for the certificate and key files.

options.name: ip
options.description: IP (or list of IPs) to be included in the certificate. IPs can be IPv4, IPv6 or both. Also can provide the default value for I(common_name).

options.name: issuer
options.description: The name of the issuer at the CA that will issue the certificate. The interpretation of the issuer may vary depending on each provider, and may be ignored if the CA only has one or a default issuer.

options.name: key_size
options.description: Generate keys with a specific keysize in bits, by default 2048.

options.name: key_usage
options.description: Allowed Key Usage for the certificate.

options.name: locality
options.description: Locality requested for the certificate subject (usually city).

options.name: mode
options.description: The file system permissions for the certificate and key files.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the certificate. Can be either a full path where files will be stored or a just a simple file name to be stored in I(directory).

options.name: organization
options.description: Organization requested for the certificate subject.

options.name: organizational_unit
options.description: Organizational unit requested for the certificate subject.

options.name: owner
options.description: User name (or user id) for the certificate and key files.

options.name: principal
options.description: Kerberos principal.

options.name: provider
options.description: The underlying method used to request and manage the certificate.

options.name: provider_config_directory
options.description: Directory where pre/post run scripts will be stored.

options.name: run_after
options.description: Command that should run after saving the certificate.

options.name: run_before
options.description: Command that should run before saving the certificate.

options.name: state
options.description: State requested for the certificate subject.

options.name: wait
options.description: If the role should block while waiting for the certificate to be issued.
